usedFor: Recruitee holds the candidates and offers, and Google Drive shares a file after “Candidate Moved to Stage”.

bestTemplate.name: “Candidate Moved to Stage” in Recruitee, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A stage change is a real hiring step, so the file for that stage can be shared then.

watchOut: “Candidate Moved to Stage” does not fire when a candidate enters the initial stage.
